Road.

Metalmobs is a motorcycle club for riders who see the road as a bond, not a race. We ride together, fix each other’s bikes, and show up when a brother needs us. Replace this with your club’s own story: when you started, where you ride from, and what makes the mob yours.

  • Brothers first
  • Ride safe, ride proud
  • Respect every machine
  • Never leave a rider behind

The club code

Loyalty

We back each other on the road and off it. A member’s problem is the mob’s problem.

Safety

Helmets on, formation tight, signals clear. Every ride ends with everyone home.

Respect

For every rider, every bike, every road and every town we pass through.

Brotherhood

Rain or shine, we ride. Group rides, repairs, charity drives and late-night chai stops.
